name: comp-293

frames.best_why: Clean card at rest with headline, copy, both buttons and the close icon unmasked by the cursor.

tagline: Small dark card with a cookie headline, two short buttons and a close X.
summary: A non-blocking cookie notice. It explains how cookies are used, offers Accept and Decline, and carries a close icon in the corner.
appearance: A dark rounded card with a thin border and soft shadow. A bold headline with a cookie emoji sits above two grey lines of copy, with a white Accept button and an outlined Decline button at the lower left and a small X at the top right.
behaviour: The card holds still. Accept, Decline and the close icon react to hover and press with fill and opacity changes; in the clip the card never actually closes.
demo_content: Headline "We Value Your Privacy" with a cookie emoji above a line about cookies and personalized content.
search_phrases: cookie notification with accept and decline
privacy popup at bottom of page
small card asking to allow cookies
use_when: A site must collect cookie consent without blocking the page, as a corner card rather than a full dialog.
avoid_when: Nothing is wired: the buttons and close X have no handlers, so saving a choice and dismissing are on you.
customise: Headline, copy and button labels are fixed in the file, so reuse means editing the source; it takes no props and the controls carry no handlers.
weight_why: A static card with three buttons and one small close icon; no runtime loop.

a11y.note: Keyboard reachable with a labelled close button, but the card has no live-region or landmark role for screen readers.

issues: Buttons and the close X have no handlers, so the card cannot be dismissed.
polish_why: Tidy spacing and clear hierarchy; flat apart from the single emoji.
